evidence.description: The response and error parameters are discarded, and any non-nil data is turned into an item, sent, and cached.

candidates.explanation: The completion handler discards both the response and error. A failure with no data produces no observable completion or failure indication here, while any returned data is published and cached without checking whether the HTTP response represents success. An HTTP error body can therefore become a cached image item.
candidates.title: Download failures and HTTP responses are ignored

evidence.description: A cache miss immediately starts a download without checking for an existing in-flight request.
Cancellation selects only the first task with a matching URL.
Each download invocation creates and resumes a new data task; caching occurs only after data arrives.

candidates.explanation: Only completed items are checked before starting a download. Repeated loads for the same URL before completion each create another network task, causing redundant requests and potentially repeated publications. The URL-specific cancellation method cancels only the first matching task, leaving other matching downloads running.
candidates.title: Concurrent loads for the same URL create duplicate downloads

evidence.description: The instance retains a set of downloaded items.
Downloaded items are inserted into the retained set.
Each cached item retains the downloaded Data payload.

candidates.explanation: Every successfully downloaded URL adds an item containing its full Data payload to the instance's set. The class has no eviction or clearing path, so retained memory grows with the distinct URLs loaded for the lifetime of the instance.
candidates.title: Downloaded data is retained without a cache bound or eviction

evidence.description: The URLSession is injected rather than created exclusively by the instance.
Both cancellation methods enumerate session-wide tasks without an ownership filter.

candidates.explanation: The session is supplied externally, but cancellation searches all tasks in that session without tracking which tasks this Images instance created. If the session is shared, cancellAll cancels unrelated work, and cancel(_:) can select another consumer's task for the same URL.
candidates.title: Cancellation is not scoped to downloads created by this instance
